title: perf(test): split root vitest run into unit (node) and dom projects
body:
## Why

The CI `Test` job is the critical path: 9m37s on PRs / 11m38s on pushes. The vitest summary from run [29341926568](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/29341926568) shows where that time goes:

```
Duration 576.10s (transform 37.47s, setup 1212.78s, import 55.16s, tests 128.73s, environment 222.83s)
```

**The 5,847 test bodies take ~2 minutes; per-file setup takes ~20 minutes cumulative.** Root cause: the `environmentMatchGlobs`-based node/DOM split silently stopped working when Vitest 4 removed the option, so every file — including ~230 pure-logic `.test.ts` files — ran in happy-dom and executed the heavy DOM setup (`vitest.setup.dom.tsx` imports `@object-ui/components` / `fields` / `plugin-dashboard` / `plugin-grid` from source and re-registers widgets). With `isolate: true`, that module graph re-executes for every single file.

## What

- Root `vitest.config.mts` now defines two inline projects (both `extends: true`):
  - **`unit`** — `**/*.test.ts`, node environment, `vitest.setup.base.ts` only (polyfills, no component imports).
  - **`dom`** — `**/*.test.tsx` plus an explicit list of 16 `.test.ts` files that genuinely need a DOM (`renderHook` via @testing-library, or direct `window` use), happy-dom, full DOM setup.
- `apps/console/vitest.config.ts` pins the DOM setup explicitly since the root no longer sets global `setupFiles`.
- Deleted dead e2e weight that never ran in CI: `e2e/view-workflows.spec.ts` (12/12 tests `test.skip`), `e2e/sidebar-text-visibility.spec.ts` (2/2 skipped), and the now-orphaned `e2e/helpers/auth.ts`.

## Verification

- `vitest run --project=unit`: **217 files / 2,953 tests green in 95 s, setup down to 2.6 s cumulative**.
- The four `window`-dependent files surfaced by the first full run were moved to the `dom` list and pass there (113 tests).
- Full suite run locally: 485 passed / 1 skipped before the final file moves; the only deltas since are those four files changing project.
- `playwright test --list --project=chromium` still collects cleanly after the spec deletions.

## Expected effect

The `unit` half of the suite drops from ~2.5 s per-file overhead to near zero; CI `Test` job should fall from ~10 min to roughly 5–7 min (the `dom` project is now the remaining cost — further wins would come from trimming the DOM setup's source-imports or the app-shell suite, tracked separately).

## Not in this PR (follow-ups from the CI-time evaluation)

- `packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts` (37 s single file — spawns the real CLI per test).
- The 7 package vitest configs that inherit the root `projects` list and re-run the whole monorepo suite when run standalone.
- Re-pruning the app-shell view-render tests that overlap plugin unit tests and e2e smoke coverage.
